angleRead.name: Carmen Delaine
angleRead.text: I’m digging into the West Oakland Stabilization Fund’s disbursement phase. The initiative passed, but I want to track where the money’s going and how it’s being managed. I’ll start by reaching out to locals who might have seen or felt its impact—servers, bakery workers, baristas—people on the ground. I’m curious if the fund’s promises are lining up with reality.
